# Experiment DLG-EXP-001 of docs/spec/dialog.md, section 16: load.
# Source: the log of the vanilla server. The data pack "dlg" is enabled. Each line is the feedback
# of one command of the form "dialog show <player> <inline dialog>". The target player is not
# online, so the feedback "No player was found" means that the dialog value decoded.

# One edit: the name of the map type in an error text is replaced with <map>.
#
